svg.title: Daily GPP, Reco, gap-filled NEE and precipitation around the 5 events whose second date is more than 12 days from the date in the database. The solid line marks the database date, the dashed line the other date; the bands are the days of each.
svg.desc: 5 panels, one per event. X axis: date (local time). Left y axis: g C m-2 d-1 (GPP solid blue, Reco dashed orange, NEE dotted black; NEE < 0 = uptake). Right y axis: precipitation in mm per day (bars). The span runs from 10 days before the earlier date to 10 days after the later end day. Anttila harvest, database date 2022-08-08 and other date 2022-09-08 (+31 days). Around the database date (2022-08-08): GPP 12.32 before and 3.63 after, change −8.70 (−71 %); Reco 8.11 and 7.05, change −1.06 (−13 %); NEE −4.21 and 3.42 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 17.6 and 16.8 degC; precipitation 14 and 0 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Around the other date (2022-09-08): GPP 5.92 before and 4.54 after, change −1.39 (−23 %); Reco 3.88 and 3.56, change −0.31 (−8 %); NEE −2.05 and −0.97 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 7.8 and 10.1 degC; precipitation 0 and 10 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Lowest daily GPP of the span: 2.64 on 2022-08-12; highest: 13.65 on 2022-08-01; precipitation of the span 65 mm. Qvidja fertilisation, database date 2020-07-27 and other date 2020-05-25 (-63 days). Around the database date (2020-07-27): GPP 8.68 before and 6.85 after, change −1.83 (−21 %); Reco 6.88 and 4.64, change −2.24 (−33 %); NEE −1.80 and −2.21 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 15.7 and 16.9 degC; precipitation 24 and 5 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Around the other date (2020-05-25): GPP 6.92 before and 11.96 after, change 5.04 (73 %); Reco 2.58 and 6.97, change 4.39 (170 %); NEE −4.34 and −4.99 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 8.8 and 14.1 degC; precipitation 1 and 0 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Lowest daily GPP of the span: 2.91 on 2020-05-16; highest: 16.62 on 2020-06-10; precipitation of the span 165 mm. Qvidja grazing, database date 2021-08-23 to 2021-08-29 and other date 2021-06-01 to 2021-06-07 (-83 days). Around the database date (2021-08-23 to 2021-08-29): GPP 5.89 before and 7.38 after, change 1.50 (25 %); Reco 4.54 and 4.69, change 0.15 (3 %); NEE −1.35 and −2.70 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 14.9 and 11.5 degC; precipitation 70 and 1 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Around the other date (2021-06-01 to 2021-06-07): GPP 10.12 before and 9.31 after, change −0.81 (−8 %); Reco 3.99 and 4.17, change 0.17 (4 %); NEE −6.13 and −5.14 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 10.9 and 16.3 degC; precipitation 37 and 28 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Lowest daily GPP of the span: 0.63 on 2021-08-07; highest: 13.48 on 2021-06-13; precipitation of the span 300 mm. Qvidja grazing, database date 2022-08-05 to 2022-08-19 and other date 2022-06-01 to 2022-06-15 (-65 days). Around the database date (2022-08-05 to 2022-08-19): GPP 6.80 before and 3.74 after, change −3.06 (−45 %); Reco 4.50 and 4.86, change 0.35 (8 %); NEE −2.29 and 1.12 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 17.1 and 18.1 degC; precipitation 0 and 36 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Around the other date (2022-06-01 to 2022-06-15): GPP 4.67 before and 6.05 after, change 1.38 (29 %); Reco 4.62 and 4.09, change −0.53 (−11 %); NEE −0.06 and −1.96 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 11.9 and 15.9 degC; precipitation 8 and 7 mm (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Lowest daily GPP of the span: −1.00 on 2022-08-17; highest: 8.81 on 2022-07-22; precipitation of the span 189 mm. Haltiala spraying, database date 2025-06-16 and other date 2025-05-16 (-31 days). Around the database date (2025-06-16): GPP 10.41 before and 12.71 after, change 2.29 (22 %); Reco 6.11 and 7.67, change 1.56 (25 %); NEE −4.30 and −5.04 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 14.7 and 14.1 degC; no precipitation data (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Around the other date (2025-05-16): GPP −0.14 before and 0.24 after, change 0.38; Reco 1.60 and 2.51, change 0.91 (57 %); NEE 1.74 and 2.28 g C m-2 d-1; air temperature 8.4 and 12.3 degC; no precipitation data (7 days before the first day and 7 days after the end day, 5 or more values per side for a change). Lowest daily GPP of the span: −0.90 on 2025-05-17; highest: 18.35 on 2025-06-26; no precipitation data.
